lessons: drift phonk is THE genre for car edits - 140-170 BPM, most sit 140-160
TR-808 COWBELL is the single most recognisable phonk signature - not optional
808 bass must be DISTORTED and pitch-SLIDING, not clean sub - mid-range growl
saturation, bitcrush and tape distortion are the aesthetic, not defects to fix
Memphis phonk 130-150 BPM, drift phonk 140-170 - drift is the car-edit variant
visual vocabulary: drifts, rolling shots, heavy colour grade, slow-mo highlights, burst effects
my Crown bed was 90 BPM marimba + warm pad - wrong on tempo, timbre, distortion and signature instrument
car cinematic edit vocabulary: FAST CUT, cut-to-beat, masking, dolly in/dolly out, speed ramp
at 145 BPM beat=0.414s - fast cut means 1-2 beats per shot (0.41-0.83s), not 1.3-2.7s
my Crown shots were 1.33-2.67s = far too slow for the genre
pacing.py has no car_edit profile - hero band 10-30 cpm is wrong, car edits run 40-90 cpm
speed ramp and masking are transitions I have code for but have NEVER looked at
VIEWED transitions frame-by-frame for the first time: whip reads as a DEFOCUS not a pan - blur is isotropic, no directional streak, no frame translation
mask transition produces NO visible mask - it is a straight cut
zoomblur produces no visible zoom blur - also a straight cut
2 of 3 transitions do nothing visible. Wiring them into the Crown would NOT have fixed his complaint
a real whip needs LINEAR directional blur along the pan axis + rapid frame translation, not boxblur
dense frame strips (every frame across the seam) are the ONLY way to review a transition - 3 stills cannot show motion
Mercedes S450 W223: ILLUMINATED radiator grille (enlarged 20%) and ILLUMINATED hood star - the car literally emits light, which matches the reference finding exactly
S450 grille: three twin chrome louvres + high-gloss black vertical bars
S-Class has three distinctive LED light accents + pronounced front bumper air intakes
S450 is an executive limousine, not a sports car - the edit should feel weighty and expensive, not aggressive drift

J300 ZX exterior: THREE-EYE / triple LED headlamp cluster is the signature - four horizontal grille slats, polished 20-inch alloys, power tailgate. NOT the US 250-series Land Cruiser (round retro lamps) - different vehicle entirely
ZX interior: 12.3in T-EMV touchscreen, JBL 14-speaker, semi-aniline leather (beige common), 7-seat with power-fold third row, ambient lighting, ventilated+heated front AND rear
Rear entertainment = dual 11.6in screens, ZX/Sahara-ZX only. A visible differentiator to shoot for a review
Malaysian recond framing: J300 ZX sells as Japan Grade 5A unregistered, RM330k-400k+. Audience cares about grade sheet, AP status and spec level - that is the review hook, not 0-100
ZX 3.5L twin-turbo V6 petrol 4WD 7-seater is the common Japan-export ZX config. Pearl white is the volume colour in export listings

fx.whip bug: _xfade injects pre_a/pre_b as [0:v]<filter> - they apply to the ENTIRE clip, not the seam. xfade duration governs the blend only. Any future pre-filter transition must be time-gated with enable='between(t,..)' or it smears whole shots

COST PREFLIGHT 2026-07-31 measured: seedance_2_0 720p std 5s = 22.5cr (4.5/s); FAST 720p 5s = 17.5cr flat, 10s = 35cr (3.5/s). nano_banana_pro plate = 2cr. D1 confirmed still live - std is the default and quotes 22.5, not 17.5

seedance_2_0 accepts image_references (PLURAL) - so a two-named-subject shot (Nev + the car) can carry BOTH locked plates on the same generation. This is the fix for car_review, which the single start_image pattern could not do
BMW i8 signature: BUTTERFLY/SCISSOR doors hinged at the A-pillar rising theatrically - the single most recognisable i8 move. 50% lighter via aluminium+carbon+thermoplastic

World's FIRST production car with LASER headlights. A passively lit BLUE BAND inside the lamp signals the laser unit - that blue accent is the i8's night signature and matches the 'car emits light' pillar finding exactly
Floating rear buttresses / stream-flow black C-pillar with an air channel through it - the profile silhouette nothing else shares
Carbon-fibre life module with a visible carbon sill, low wide stance, sloping roofline, BMW i BLUE accents on the kidney grille surround and side skirts
Adaptive rear spoiler, integrated diffuser, active air flaps, 20-inch turbine-style alloys with aero covers
i8 profile: floating rear buttresses + sloping roofline give it hypercar presence at a fraction of the price - the silhouette IS the hook
BMW i BLUE accent runs the kidney surround, side skirts and the laser lamp band. Blue+black+white is the i8 palette - do NOT grade it warm
Recond/used i8 now sits near entry-supercar money - the Malaysian angle is 'supercar looks, hybrid running cost'
Interior: driver-angled cockpit, floating console, blue ambient strips, thin sculpted seats. Reads futuristic, not luxurious - different from the LC300 cabin
TikTok Q2 2026: the algorithm prioritises 3-SECOND RETENTION over watch time. Hook rate target ~40% TikTok / ~30% Meta. If they do not stop in 3s the video dies - watch time cannot rescue it
CAR EDITS SPECIFICALLY: start with IMMEDIATE MOTION. Final check before posting is the first 3 seconds. Our LC300 opened on a near-static wheel - the least surprising thing a car can show
Hooks UNDER 2 SECONDS had 23% higher completion than 4-5s hooks (n=10,000 viral TikToks). So the event must be over inside ~2s, not built up to
Reels/TikTok reward a SINGLE EVENT - one acceleration burst, one cornering moment - not a walkaround tour. The LC300 was a tour: 14 shots of a car being looked at, nothing happening TO it
BMW i8 is named among the butterfly-door cars that reliably generate viral content. The doors ARE the event - it is the one thing this car does that nothing else on a Malaysian road does

BMW'S OWN PRESS SHOT LIST for the i8 - the manufacturer's coverage plan: front view, front spoiler, 3/4 front, DOOR (stop motion), LIGHT (stop motion), side, 3/4 rear, roof, DOOR OPEN, logo, DOOR AND LIGHT rear stop-motion, i8 logo / interior: DOOR OPEN zoom in, wheel, screen, seat, dash / driving shots incl onboard door and wheel. THE DOOR APPEARS 4 TIMES. BMW themselves treat it as the hero shot
The published i8 photo work that circulates is NIGHT work - shot around a city at night for dealer social. Night is the i8's native register because the blue laser band only reads in the dark

lessons: PLATE v1 FAILED SUBJECT VERIFICATION. Naming a part does not generate it. 'swan-neck rear wing' returned a generic GT wing on STRAIGHT PEDESTALS FROM BELOW, and 'canards' returned a bare bumper. 4cr wasted.

PLATE v2 PASSED by DESCRIBING THE GEOMETRY instead of naming it: 'two curved arms rise from the deck, arch UP and OVER the wing, bolt to its UPPER surface, NOTHING underneath' produced a correct swan-neck. 'two small angled fins stacked one above the other on each bumper corner' produced correct canards.
GENERALISATION: for any named trim part, write the shape and the mounting, plus a negative naming the wrong version. Jargon is not a spec.
Matt black paint generated well first time from 'ABSORBS light, form through soft sheen and edge highlights, NOT glossy reflections'.
WATCH: v2 has a softbox visible top-left and the wing hardware reads polished metal rather than carbon weave. Neither is identity-breaking; both were declared before generation, not discovered after.

The Supra has no door theatre like the i8's butterfly doors, so the 2-second event is HUMAN: Nev drops in, door thumps, straight-six fires and the car shakes. A face at second zero - the thing the LC300 never had.
